slides.title: Follow the ownership boundary
slides.takeaway: Library: Usage cards/tables plus exported mapping utilities.
slides.notes: The library owns Usage cards/tables plus exported mapping utilities. The host owns Fetching usage, choosing locale/timezone formatting and passing resolved display values.  The arrows show data/callback direction, not an implicit network request. The documented isolation rules and known implementation deviations are listed in qa-report.md.

cards.title: Mapping exports
cards.body: Usage-to-dashboard and model-limit mapping helpers are public exports.

slides.notes: Customization comes from the current exports and prop declarations. Semantic states: UsageLimitStatus distinguishes normal, warning and reached states. Accessible progress: Supply preformatted progressAriaLabel and reset text. Mapping exports: mapUsageDataToDashboard and model-limit mappers are public. For UI, import the package stylesheet and use documented props or stable public classes. A component-level color override and inherited theme tokens are different levels of control. Locale strings and direction should be supplied by the host; do not introduce app i18n into a reusable library.

slides.title: Constraints that affect integration

cards.title: Calendar periods
cards.body: Today/week/month are calendar windows, not rolling durations.

cards.title: Components and helpers
cards.body: Cards consume display data; exported helpers do perform mapping.

cards.title: Isolation discrepancy
cards.body: Mapping source imports generated API DTOs outside the documented exception.

slides.notes: Review these constraints before choosing the library. Calendar periods: Today/week/month are calendar windows, not rolling durations. Separate component and helper: Cards consume display data; exported helpers do perform mapping. Isolation discrepancy: Mapping source imports generated API DTOs outside the documented exception. The package is private in this snapshot. The presence of build/publish tooling is not evidence that a compatible release is available from a registry.
